detections.summary: Host describes a lower back injury that leaves him unable to stand, with shooting leg pain; co-hosts suspect a bulging disc and debate muscle versus disc causes.

detections.evidence_quote: I can't go to a doctor now because every doctor is busy shooting people up with 5G.
detections.summary: Sarcastic aside that doctors are too busy injecting people with 5G, a mocking nod to the vaccine-5G trope.

detections.evidence_quote: I've been taking muscle relaxers at night.
detections.summary: Host says he has been taking muscle relaxers at night for the back pain.

detections.evidence_quote: Well, I have one too.
detections.summary: Co-host cites having a bulging disc himself as grounds that it goes away.

detections.evidence_quote: You have to start stretching, like all the time.
detections.summary: Advice he has received is that constant stretching and exercise, including ab work, are needed to relieve the back pain and prevent recurrence, rather than a pill or patch.

detections.evidence_quote: Just rubbing CBD on my spine.
detections.summary: Host mentions rubbing CBD on his spine for the back pain.

detections.summary: Hosts argue whether the pain is muscular or skeletal and conclude a bulging disc is pressing on the sciatic nerve.

detections.evidence_quote: Some HGH.
detections.summary: Joking suggestion that he take human growth hormone for his back.

detections.evidence_quote: I already alluded to it, but Billy convinced me I had COVID on Sunday.
detections.summary: Host recounts a co-host convincing him he had COVID, checking his temperature all week, and the co-host saying muscle and back aches are a COVID sign.

detections.evidence_quote: I had I had food poisoning, and I told them I had food poisoning. I puked twice, and then I was fine on Saturday night.
detections.summary: Host says he actually had food poisoning from Chinese food, vomited twice and recovered, though others who ate it were fine.

detections.evidence_quote: Okay, I'm not, Doctor Jill Biden.

verification_candidates.rationale: General claim about how back pain is treated and prevented that evidence on exercise therapy can assess.

verification_candidates.rationale: Mechanistic claim about disc-related nerve pain that anatomy evidence can check.

verification_candidates.evidence_quote: So you you you have to do stretches. It will slowly go down, and then it will be with you for the rest.
verification_candidates.rationale: Claim about the treatment and course of a bulging disc that could mislead someone managing back pain.
